D65 / A：360–830 nm；CWF / F7 / TL84 / U30:
D65 / A: 360–830 nm; CWF / F7 / TL84 / U30: 380–780 nm.
Lab / Luv use the library's fixed white points, which may differ slightly from the white point integrated over the selected range. sRGB previews are available for D65; out-of-gamut colors are clipped.
The tinted 380–780 nm background approximates visible light on screen and only indicates wavelength positions.
先显示标样与样品的 sRGB 屏幕预览，随后显示标样 L*、a*、b* 和样品:
Results show standard and sample sRGB previews, followed by six input-value columns for standard L*, a*, b* and sample L*, a*, b*, then ΔL*, Δa*, Δb*, ΔC*, Δh°, ΔE76, CMC and ΔE00.
Differences are sample minus standard; Δh° is the shortest signed Lab hue-angle difference. Previews use D65 / 10° with gamut clipping. Column headers include formula parameters. Up to 10,000 rows per calculation.
ΔE00 固定 kL:kC:kH = 1:1:1；CMC 可选择或自定义 l:c:
ΔE00 uses fixed kL:kC:kH = 1:1:1; CMC supports presets or custom l:c. Thresholds allow up to four decimals, with a minimum of 0.0001.
Grades count steps along each direction. Cumulative ΔE from the standard may differ from grade count × threshold. Each outward CMC step uses the previous grade as its reference.
Previews use D65 / 10° with sRGB gamut clipping. Positions that reach coordinate limits or cannot meet the threshold are unavailable.
